mcat_description.short: Wooden Cabins are prefabricated or portable structures built with timber frames and wooden cladding, sold as complete units or kits for residential, hospitality, and site-office applications across India.
mcat_description.long: Wooden Cabins in the Indian B2B market are factory-manufactured prefabricated structures using timber frames (pine, SPF, teak, or engineered wood) clad with plywood, WPC, or sandwich panels, designed for rapid on-site assembly. They serve a wide range of applications including resort cottages, eco-resort glamping pods, garden cabins, rooftop structures, site offices, and portable security booths. Structural variants range from compact portable units to fully customised multi-room cottages with insulation, UPVC windows, electrical fittings, and weatherproof membranes. Buyers typically procure on a per-project basis with dimensions, wood species, insulation grade, and finish specified at order.

market_context: The Indian prefab wooden cabin market spans two broad commercial segments: (1) portable/site-use wooden cabins (compact, plywood or WPC-clad, used as site offices, security booths, or retail kiosks) and (2) custom prefabricated wooden cottages and resort cabins (timber-frame, fully insulated, used in hospitality, farmhouse, and residential projects). The hospitality and eco-tourism segment is the most commercially prominent, with manufacturers supplying resort developers, glamping operators, and hotel chains across India. Common timber species used include Canadian SPF (Spruce-Pine-Fir), Russian pine, and teak; PEFC and FSC certification is increasingly cited by quality manufacturers. Engineered wood products such as CLT and GLT are emerging as premium structural options. The India prefab wood building market is projected to grow at approximately 6.89% CAGR through 2031, driven by urbanisation, eco-tourism growth, and government housing initiatives (PMAY, Smart Cities). No single BIS IS standard specific to wooden cabins was confirmed from available sources — structural design typically follows general timber construction guidelines (single source — low confidence for BIS standard claim). Sellers are concentrated in Delhi NCR, Goa, Bengaluru, Thane/Mumbai, and Coimbatore.
